messages.subject: Income update - week ending 23 October
messages.snippet:
Hi all,

Here is the income position for the week ending Friday 23 October. Collection for the year to date stands at 97.4% of the rent debi...
messages.body:
Hi all,

Here is the income position for the week ending Friday 23 October. Collection for the year to date stands at 97.4% of the rent debit, which is a little behind the same point last year, mostly because of the timing of the Universal Credit managed migration letters in the Weavers Rise and Cragg View patches.

Universal Credit: 188 households have now moved across. The first assessment period leaves most of them a month behind, so please do not treat a new UC arrear as a reason to change anything on a repair or a transfer application without talking to us first. Omar is running the alternative payment arrangement requests and has eleven open.

Court: Two possession hearings are listed at Wyndale County Court on 5 November; both tenants have been offered a payment plan again this week. We are not taking anyone to court whose arrears are only the UC waiting period.

Hardship fund: the fund has GBP 6,200 left for this financial year. Danielle can refer tenants who are struggling with energy bills as well as rent; the panel meets on the second Tuesday.

Direct debit drive: 41 tenants have switched to direct debit since the September newsletter. Thank you to the contact centre for mentioning it on calls.

Repairs compensation run: as section 8 of the repairs service standard asks, these are the tenants whose rent accounts are in arrears at close of business today, for the repairs compensation run. Any award to one of these tenants goes to the rent account, not to the bank: T-10403, T-10416, T-10424, T-10433, T-10443, T-10464, T-11683, T-11770, T-11906, T-11933, T-13132.

Former tenant arrears: the debt agency has recovered GBP 1,140 this month.

As always, give us a shout if a tenant tells you about a change in their circumstances.

Philippa

Philippa Drake
Income Manager, Thornbeck Homes
01632 960 300
